card.name: Time of day in dosing directions
card.fires_on: The word "the" or "in" in the phrase "once daily in the morning/evening" within dosing instructions. It also fires on "morning" in "with the morning and evening meals".

modes.label: in the (morning/evening)
modes.description: The word "the" after "once daily in", just before morning or evening.
modes.example: Take Dapagliflozin and Metformin HCl extended-release tablets orally once daily in<< the>> morning with food.

modes.label: preferably in the evening
modes.example: Quetiapine extended-release tablets should be administered once daily, preferably<< in>> the evening.

modes.label: with the morning meal
modes.description: The word "morning" in a twice-daily meal-timing phrase.
modes.example: Metformin HCl Tablets are 2.5 mg/500 mg or 5 mg/500 mg twice daily with the<< morning>> and evening meals.

card.plain: It marks the spot in a once-daily dose instruction where the time of day (morning or evening) comes next.
